quantiles: Nearest-rank; repetition 0 excluded separately for every fixture/mode/backend. Edits within a session are correlated.

methodology.main: Production controller/renderers in actual VS Code postMessage webviews; paced source mutations, navigation, zoom and magnification. Two-rAF paint opportunity after matching mount ACK, or after revealing a valid resident surface. No physical scanout/GPU-completion claim.
methodology.rapid: Open-loop 12 inserts + 12 backspaces at 100 ms; TikZ also 8 coordinate edits at 125 ms. Full source sync/controller/paint path, injected source changes rather than physical keyboard routing.
methodology.prewarm: Same TikZ burst, production prepareEdit API explicitly completed before coordinate phase; preparation time reported separately.
methodology.density: Full PNG export, seven unique nearby requested widths per group, no encoded cache hits; native timings exclude compile/startup/browser. RGB hashing after all timing. 4 MP vs 16 MP opt-in; production extension cap unchanged.
methodology.builds: Same imported production engine source; same XeTeX worker hash and cached compact MuPDF/ICU objects. Backend differs only for preview PNG. Engine manifest 1620b15 production code matches native 1b895fc, whose only extra change is activity test compatibility.
methodology.power: AC power; per-session power snapshots retained. Low power mode 0. No downloads. Native engines headless. Main/rapid/density/control ran serially; profiling/build jobs in other chat paused.
methodology.exclusions: Warm-ups and dedicated smoke/debug runs excluded. Interrupted regression run discarded. All measured main rows use the same repaired harness; metadata preserves warm-up resumptions.
methodology.memory: Native viewer lifetime peak and sampled process-group task sums, not deduplicated physical RAM. JS/DOM/canvas counters exclude total Chromium/GPU resources.
